major_deviations.claim_in_article: The Outer Space Treaty bans placing nuclear weapons and other weapons of mass destruction in orbit around Earth, as well as placing weapons on celestial bodies.
major_deviations.issue: The wording says the treaty prohibits placing weapons on celestial bodies generally. The Ledger supports a ban on placing nuclear weapons and other weapons of mass destruction there, and separately lists prohibitions on military bases, weapons testing, and military maneuvers; it does not establish a blanket ban on placing all weapons on celestial bodies.
major_deviations.explanation: The claim broadens the treaty prohibition beyond the weapons covered by the Ledger; the same broad wording is already present in the Japanese source.
